drafts.lead: G'Sean Williams, Managing Partner, PSM Workforce — 'Sure. Give me summary details', waiting 7 hours
drafts.body:
G'Sean,

Apologies for the wait, and here is the summary you asked for.

What we do: we run outbound campaigns on your behalf. We build the list of companies that need procurement and supply chain talent, register separate sending domains and mailboxes so psmworkforce.com is never put at risk, warm them, then email in your name. Anyone interested replies directly to you and the relationship is yours from the first message.

What we are not: we do not sell you a contact list, we do not make introductions to people we already represent, and we take nothing on what you place.

Commercials: flat monthly retainer, not per lead and not a percentage.

What you would see: replies from named people at fitting companies landing in your inbox, typically starting in the third or fourth week once the sending infrastructure is warm.

If that is worth twenty minutes:

• Monday, August 17 at 9:00 AM EDT
• Monday, August 17 at 2:00 PM EDT
• Tuesday, August 18 at 2:00 PM EDT

Alyssa

drafts.lead: Zoey Hollar, COO — follow-up: who is reaching out to the manufacturers, is this offshore help, pay upon closed leads?
drafts.body:
Zoey,

Three fair questions, three straight answers.

Who is reaching out. The emails go out under Heckaman & Hollar, from mailboxes we set up on domains that look like yours rather than from anything branded Koldify. So the manufacturer sees your company, not an agency. Nobody is phoning anyone, it is email only, and no one is speaking to your market as though they work for you beyond that.

Is this offshore help. We are a lead generation business. That is the whole of what we do: build the list, run the outbound, and send you the replies. There is no other service bundled underneath it and nobody is being put on the phone to your market.

Pay upon closed leads. No. Flat monthly retainer. We take nothing when you close a shipper and nothing per lead, which also means we have no incentive to send you volume you cannot use.

If that answers it:

• Thursday, August 13 at 2:00 PM EDT
• Monday, August 17 at 1:30 PM EDT
• Wednesday, August 19 at 1:30 PM EDT

And if the retainer model is the sticking point rather than the detail, say so plainly and I will not keep pushing.

Brooke

drafts.lead: Shubho Ghosh — will schedule a call but wants the fee structure first
drafts.body:
Shubho,

Reasonable to want that before you give up the time, so here is the structure honestly.

It is a flat monthly retainer. Not per lead, not per meeting, and no percentage of anything you place. We get paid the same whether you fill three roles or thirty, which is deliberate: paid per lead we would be pushed to send you volume, and volume is the last thing a recruiter needs.

What I cannot do is give you the number without knowing the scope, because it moves with how many companies we are going after and across how many markets. That is not a dodge to get you on a call. Tell me roughly the scale you have in mind and I will put a figure in writing before we speak, if you would rather see it first.

Otherwise these are open:

• Monday, August 17 at 9:30 AM EDT
• Tuesday, August 18 at 9:00 AM EDT
• Wednesday, August 19 at 2:00 PM EDT

Abigail
